content.text:
```yaml
package_name: macports
slots:
  - category: identity
    name: name
    value: MacPorts
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Page Title"
    
  - category: identity
    name: version
    value: "2.11.6"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"
    
  - category: identity
    name: description
    value: "An easy-to-use system for compiling, installing, and managing open source software on macOS"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Meta description"
    
  - category: identity
    name: homepage
    value: "https://www.macports.org"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - URL"
    
  - category: platform
    name: supported_os
    value: ["darwin"]
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS versions listed"
    annotation: "Supports macOS Tahoe v26, Sequoia v15, Sonoma v14, Ventura v13, and older versions back to Leopard"
    
  - category: dependency
    name: prerequisite
    value: "Apple's Command Line Developer Tools"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Quickstart section"
    
  - category: installation
    name: prerequisite_install_command
    value: "xcode-select --install"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Quickstart and Installing sections"
    
  - category: installation
    name: pkg_installer_url
    value: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base/releases/download/v2.11.6/"
    confidence: 0.9
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS Package Installer section"
    annotation: "Specific URLs available for different macOS versions"
    
  - category: installation
    name: source_download_url
    value: "https://distfiles.macports.org/MacPorts/MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.bz2"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "MacPorts Guide - Source Install section"
    
  - category: installation
    name: source_install_commands
    value: 
      - "tar xjvf MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.bz2"
      - "cd MacPorts-2.11.6"
      - "./configure && make && sudo make install"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Source Installation section"
    
  - category: installation
    name: git_clone_url
    value: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base.git"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "MacPorts Guide - Git Install section"
    
  - category: configuration
    name: default_prefix
    value: "/opt/local"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document and MacPorts Guide"
    annotation: "Can be customized with --prefix during source installation"
    
  - category: configuration
    name: path_setup
    value: "Add ${prefix}/bin and ${prefix}/sbin to the start of PATH"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Source Installation section"
    
  - category: configuration
    name: shell_config_update
    value: "Installer automatically adapts shell configuration files"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS Package Installer section"
    
  - category: verification
    name: version_check_command
    value: "port version"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "MacPorts Guide - Package Install section"
    
  - category: configuration
    name: post_install_update
    value: "sudo port -v selfupdate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - multiple sections"
    annotation: "Should be run regularly to keep MacPorts current"
    
  - category: dependency
    name: optional_dependency
    value: "Apple's Xcode Developer Tools"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"
    annotation: "Required when building some ports from source"
    
  - category: configuration
    name: xcode_license_acceptance
    value: "xcodebuild -license"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"
    annotation: "Required with Xcode 4 and later"
    
  - category: dependency
    name: optional_x11
    value: "X11 windowing environment"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"
    annotation: "For ports that depend on X11 functionality"
    
  - category: feature
    name: binary_archives
    value: "Automatic installation from prebuilt binary archives when available"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - Does MacPorts always build from source section"
    
  - category: conflict
    name: conflicting_paths
    value: "/usr/local"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - Can I install software in /usr/local section"
    annotation: "Software in /usr/local can interfere with MacPorts builds"
    
  - category: conflict
    name: conflicting_frameworks
    value: "/Library/Frameworks"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - Can I install frameworks section"
    annotation: "Frameworks in /Library/Frameworks can interfere with MacPorts"
    
  - category: configuration
    name: migration_command
    value: "sudo port migrate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Migration Document - Migration procedure section"
    annotation: "Required after major OS upgrades or architecture changes"

sources:
  - title: "The MacPorts Project -- Download & Installation"
    url: "https://www.macports.org/install.php"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used:
      - "Quickstart"
      - "Installing MacPorts"
      - "macOS Package (.pkg) Installer"
      - "Source Installation"
      - "Git Sources"
      
  - title: "Migration – MacPorts"
    url: "https://trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used:
      - "Migration procedure"
      - "Troubleshooting"
      
  - title: "FAQ – MacPorts"
    url: "https://trac.macports.org/wiki/FAQ"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used:
      - "Does MacPorts always build from source?"
      - "Can I install software in /usr/local while using MacPorts?"
      - "Can I install frameworks in /Library/Frameworks while using MacPorts?"
      
  - title: "MacPorts Guide"
    url: "https://guide.macports.org"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used:
      - "Install MacPorts"
      - "Source Install"
      - "Git Install"
      - "MacPorts and the Shell"

ambiguities:
  - slot_name: xcode_version_requirements
    description: "Different Xcode version requirements for different macOS versions"
    options:
      - "Use latest available Xcode for your OS"
      - "Use specific minimum versions listed in documentation"
    suggested_default: "Use latest available Xcode for your OS"

tribal_knowledge:
  - title: "Migration Required for Major OS Changes"
    description: "MacPorts installations don't survive major OS upgrades or CPU architecture changes. Must run migration procedure or reinstall completely."
    source_ref: "Migration Document - Introduction"
    affects_phase: install
    
  - title: "Avoid /usr/local Conflicts"
    description: "Installing software in /usr/local while using MacPorts can cause build failures because some software looks for dependencies there first"
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - /usr/local section"
    affects_phase: install
    
  - title: "Trace Mode for Problematic Builds"
    description: "Use 'sudo port -t install <portname>' to hide /usr/local and other potential conflicts during builds"
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - trace mode explanation"
    affects_phase: install
    
  - title: "Binary Archives Default Behavior"
    description: "MacPorts automatically uses prebuilt binaries when available, but falls back to source builds for custom variants or when no binary exists"
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - binary archives section"
    affects_phase: install
    
  - title: "Regular Updates Essential"
    description: "Run 'sudo port selfupdate' regularly to keep both MacPorts base and the ports tree current"
    source_ref: "Primary Document - multiple sections"
    affects_phase: provision
    
  - title: "Shell Environment Setup"
    description: "Package installer automatically configures shell environment, but source installations require manual PATH setup"
    source_ref: "MacPorts Guide - Shell configuration sections"
    affects_phase: provision
```
